data.long_meaning: The name Dadapeer is derived from Sanskrit roots ‘Da’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘Pee’ meaning ‘beloved’. This name is often given to a boy who is believed to be favored by the gods and is considered a symbol of divine grace and blessings. The name Dadapeer carries the meaning “Beloved by the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dadapeer usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved by the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
